lines.text: Many learners say: Ana is a friend of me.
Better: Ana is a friend of mine.
Mine! She is a friend of mine.

data.wrong: Ana is a friend of me.
data.right: Ana is a friend of mine.

native.tip: Em português dizemos “uma amiga minha”; em inglês também: “a friend of mine”, nunca “of me”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “Ana is a friend of me.” O certo é “Ana is a friend of mine.” Pense em “uma amiga minha”: em inglês é “a friend of mine”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “mine”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: Say it like “uma amiga minha”: “a friend of mine”, never “of me”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “Ana is a friend of me.” The right way is “Ana is a friend of mine.” Think of “uma amiga minha”: in English it is “a friend of mine”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
